PaiNovel Terms of Service

Effective date: 2026-10-13 · Language: English

Welcome to PaiNovel. By using the app, you agree to these Terms. The current build is a functional demonstration; screens do not imply that every displayed capability is a live service.

1. Service scope

PaiNovel demonstrates novel discovery and reading, including search, library, progress, bookmarks, preferences, reviews, virtual coins, chapter unlocks, and tips. Most current behavior uses local or in-memory mock data. Only the Discover catalog calls a configured API when API_BASE_URL is supplied at build time.

2. Accounts

The current version does not support registration, sign-in, or account sync. The displayed reader name is fixed demonstration content and does not mean an account exists. Before accounts are enabled, we will add eligibility, security, termination, and deletion terms.

3. Content and acceptable use

Use the service only for personal and lawful purposes. Do not infringe rights, bypass access controls, disrupt the service, upload illegal or infringing material, or use the service for fraud. Upload and publishing screens in the operations console are demonstrations not connected to a persistent production system.

4. Virtual coins and payment

Coins, recharge, chapter unlocks, and tips are currently demonstration data. They create no real transaction, cash value, or refund entitlement, and displayed prices are not offers for sale.

If real digital transactions are enabled, the applicable store billing system will show final pricing, taxes, refund rules, and subscription terms. Virtual coins may only be used for eligible PaiNovel content and may not be redeemed for cash or transferred between users unless the law requires otherwise.

5. Intellectual property

The app, interface, marks, and operator-provided content are protected by applicable intellectual-property laws. Unless expressly authorized, you may not copy, scrape in bulk, resell, or create a derivative service. A contributor or content operator must hold the rights needed for submitted material.

6. Changes and termination

Demonstration features may be changed, suspended, or removed. After a production launch, material changes, paid entitlements, and termination will be handled under applicable law and the rules then published.

7. Disclaimers and liability

To the extent permitted by law, the demonstration is provided as is, without a promise of continuous availability, persistent storage, or fitness for a particular purpose. Nothing excludes or limits liability that cannot legally be excluded or limited.

8. Governing terms, disputes, and contact

Governing law, jurisdiction, and dispute venue depend on the operator and release markets, which remain unconfirmed and must be completed before publication. Contact: hovey@vip.qq.com. Operator: DagoodPai.
